$comment: RESERVED FOR RUNTIME VALIDATION (JSON Schema cannot enforce these): captured_at_utc must be at or after the matching request capture for the same opaque_slot_id and attempt_number (the request and response captures are temporally distinct artifacts and one may never stand in for the other); timestamp parsing and ordering; recomputation of capture_digest_sha256 against the actual capture bytes; binding of artifact_id to the downloaded artifact bytes whose digest appears in the observation artifact; agreement of returned_image_count with actual artifacts; and corroboration that recorded no_result_evidence is affirmative host-side evidence rather than an operator belief. A runtime validator must reject artifacts failing any of these even if they satisfy this schema.
title: EXP-019 v1.2 DRAFT response capture artifact (non-executable)
description: DRAFT schema for the prospective EXP-019 v1.2 evidence contract. NOT a frozen protocol and NOT executable: v1.2 is not registered in frozen_protocol(). This records the contemporaneous capture taken WHEN THE IMAGE APPEARS, establishing that a result was returned and where it sat in the conversation. It is distinct from the request capture, which is taken before any image exists. A capture is a rendering of the operator's client view; it is not authenticated host telemetry.

returned_image_count.description: Images returned by the request. The v1.2 requirement is exactly one; more than one is a demonstrated protocol violation.

artifact_id.description: Opaque handle binding the returned artifact to this request and to the downloaded bytes. Must be a non-empty string when an image was returned and must be null when no image was returned: a no-result capture must not invent an artifact handle.

no_result_evidence.description: Affirmative evidence that the host completed no image, required when image_returned is false. An operator statement that no image was seen is NOT sufficient and must not be recorded here.
